senses.gloss: m. pl. (Saf. of פרק; cmp. אַוְורַקְסִין) a sort of trousers.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 120a:8">Sabb. 120ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. XVI, 15ᵈ <cite ref="O00095"><he>סַבְרִיקִין</he></cite> (<cite ref="B01314"><he>ברק</he></cite> = <he>פרק</he>; cmp. <he>בקר</he> = <he>פקר</he>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 29:2">Kel. XXIX, 2</cite> <cite ref="O00240"><he>סוּבְרִיקִין</he></cite> (Var. <cite ref="O00276"><he>סַוְורִיקִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="O01433"><he>ספְרִיקִין</he></cite>); Sifra M’tsor‘a, Neg., Par. 7, ch. V. <cite ref="O00095"><he>סַבְרִיקִים</he></cite>.
